calculation.description: Risk-adjusted one-day reversal, amplified when observation-only VIX is above its trailing 60-session median. All inputs are observable at the decision date and the signal is used against subsequent returns.

regime_notes.interpretation: Positive daily IC in all tested regimes; daily IC and ICIR clear the benchmark gates, while predictive power decays at longer holding horizons. Cross-section averages 14.13 instruments and dates meet the >=8 observation rule.

dependencies_universe: 15 tradable benchmark instruments; VIX is observation-only and never tradable
